_comment: Grade 3 Unit 2 (Rule Makers) covers Evaluating sources/arguments but not Solving problems (3As, 'Suggest personal actions that could make a positive difference to an issue affecting others') — a natural fit for a rules-and-fairness unit. Added 2026-09-17 to close a documented Stage 3 coverage gap, in Nadia's voice, matching the unit's Berbera pool-rules example.

addExplainers.title: A rule that helps everyone
addExplainers.body:
Nadia noticed that at the pool in Berbera, some children never got a turn on the slide because bigger children kept going first. So Nadia suggested a rule: everyone takes one turn, then goes to the back of the line. That helped every child, not just Nadia.

Think of a place where you have seen this happen — the playground, the classroom, home. Suggest ONE rule that would help OTHER people, not just you.

Say your rule, and say who it would help.
bullets: Think of a place where someone is left out or treated unfairly.
Suggest one rule that would help.
Say who your rule would help, and why.
